facts.value: Eight-byte literal pool containing f32 0.0 at offset 0 and 1.0 at offset 4. The observed source object marks .sdata2 WRITE|ALLOC; the split object marks it ALLOC without SHF_WRITE. Final runtime protection is not established.
facts.rationale: Existing objects agree on bytes and size but not SHF_WRITE; the read-only claim conflates section convention with permissions.

facts.value: Receives a Fighter_GObj from a surface-reaction entry routine and forwards it unchanged to ft_80081DD4. Downstream, that helper reads the Fighter, CollData, SDI permission, ledge cooldown and collision flags, fighter-data ledge-snap height, model scale, and a common ledge-snap multiplier. It advances CollData.last_pos from CollData.cur_pos, seeds CollData.cur_pos from Fighter.cur_pos, chooses one of three map-collision queries, on the ordinary path multiplies the scale-derived ledge-snap height by common x1CC only for ECBSource_JObj and restores its unmultiplied value only for that source kind, writes the resolved CollData.cur_pos back to Fighter.cur_pos, and computes a boolean result that this wrapper discards.
facts.rationale: The callee gates both writes by ECBSource_JObj and does not establish that x1CC always enlarges the value.

evidence.why: The callee gates both writes by ECBSource_JObj and does not establish that x1CC always enlarges the value.

facts.value: Dispatches queued damage audio in immediate or hitlag-deferred processing. The hit-processing caller invokes it immediately when bool1 is zero; with bool1 nonzero, positive computed hitlag and bool2 set mark audio for dispatch when hitlag ends. A computed zero hitlag in the bool1 branch does not itself invoke this routine.
facts.rationale: Immediate playback follows the bool1==0 branch, not every interaction with zero hitlag; deferral also requires positive hitlag and bool2.

facts.value: Each pending slot is processed independently: x1908 != -1 plays the direct ID and resets it to -1; non-NULL x190C plays a randomly selected array entry and resets it to NULL. Hit processing calls immediately when bool1==0. With bool1 nonzero, positive hitlag and bool2 set raise x221A_b3; frame processing dispatches when hitlag expires and clears that flag.
facts.rationale: The caller has explicit positive-hitlag and bool2 gates on deferral, omitted by the previous unconditional otherwise claim.

facts.value: Begins Melee's airborne tumbling state, internally called DamageFall, including non-attack entries such as ledge-hang timer expiration. The Lift collision callback route can also drop a held item and invoke this entry; its enum-to-Boolean trigger is not interpreted here as loss of ground. If the fighter has an active Parasol, it preserves the item's specialized damaged-descent behavior instead of forcing the ordinary tumble motion.
facts.rationale: The verified CliffWait caller checks expiration of its hang timer, not a push.

facts.value: If ftCo_800C5240 reports no held Hammer, checks in short-circuit order: aerial special input; ftCo_80095328(gobj, 0); ftCo_800D7100; ftCo_800C3B10; airborne attack/item-throw input; ftCo_800D705C; and ftCo_800CB870. If none returns true, absolute horizontal stick >= common x210 and tilt age < common x214 enter Fall and return. Only if no earlier return occurred does it test ftCo_800C5DDC (Hammer release/drop), followed on false by ftCo_800C5CD4 (HammerFall entry). A true predicate need not change motion: ftCo_800D705C sets x209C from common x414.
facts.rationale: The guard is a Hammer-held predicate; final checks depend on no prior early return, and handled input need not imply a motion transition.
